desc:

• Live, interactive sessions (Zoom, Google Meet, or a comparable platform) that balance theory with timed practice.  
• Original or curated practice sets drawn from reliable sources such as Cambridge IELTS books, British Council materials, and up-to-date online mock tests, plus your own feedback rubric.

desc:

title: Kids App Testing & Storywriting

desc:

title: Higher Education Article Content Manager
desc:

title: Flash TRC20 Token Builder
desc:
I need a stand-alone application that lets me spin up and deploy TRC20 tokens on the Tron network in minutes for my own personal projects. The core task is token creation, but I want the process wrapped in a clean, beginner-friendly interface so I don’t have to touch the command line every time.

Key capabilities I expect:
• User-friendly interface – clear forms for token name, symbol, supply, decimals and optional parameters.  
• Customizable token parameters – burn, mint, freeze, pausable or any other standard flags should be toggleable before deployment.  
• Automatic deployment scripts – a single click compiles, deploys and returns the contract address (supporting both Shasta testnet and mainnet).

Under the hood you can choose the stack (Python, Node.js, or another language you prefer) as long as it interfaces smoothly with TronWeb / TronGrid and keeps private keys secure. I’ll need the executable, readable source code, and short documentation that shows how to install, generate a wallet, fund it, and push a new token live.

Acceptance is straightforward: I run the app, enter my parameters, press Deploy, and receive a verified TRC20 contract address that works in TronLink.

I’ll supply log-in credentials to the data feed, template spreadsheets, and short video walkthroughs so you can ramp up quickly. If you are organised, communicative, and eager to learn the ropes of trading from home, let’s get started.

Turnaround is important to me; let me know how many portraits you can comfortably handle per day and your estimated timeframe for the full batch. I’ll supply the images as soon as we agree on the schedule.
